name: AIS
fix_description: In setAdmin (0x704b6c02), there is no access control check. Any caller can change the admin address. Add onlyOwner or onlyAdmin modifier to restrict who can call setAdmin.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is multi-step and requires understanding several protocol-specific behaviors: a flash loan, AMM pair skim abuse with repeated token transfers, invoking a token-side harvest/admin takeover path, then draining and unwinding through swaps. While the PoC is not very long, the vulnerability is not an obvious single-pattern bug and requires reading interactions across the token, pair, and vulnerable admin contract.
